Virat Kohli Marks 18 Years in International Cricket

Cricketer Virat Kohli has completed 18 years in international cricket, having made his debut in 2008. Over his career, he has achieved numerous records and accolades, including World Cup and Asia Cup victories. Kohli also captained India to significant Test match wins abroad and broke Sachin Tendulkar's ODI century record during the 2023 World Cup. The number 18, his jersey number, is associated with an emotional personal story.
